question: What is the essential nature and sage of the mantra identified here?
premises: The mantra is described as having the kama-bija as its nature.
A sage is assigned to the mantra.
The sage is named as enchanting Narada.
inference: This mantra is kama-bija in nature and has enchanting Narada as its sage.
plain_english: The mantra is of the nature of the kama-seed, and its sage is enchanting Narada.
